sde-2 at slice, jadavpur university... solid trajectory from the city of joy to fintech. ios to backend in 2 months - that's either ambitious or masochistic, haven't decided yet. what made you jump ship from mobile to server-side? the ios ecosystem getting too predictable or slice needed backend firepower?
